text:
maria: Heads-up — looking at the last quarter's postmortems and there are recurring patterns we should triage (autoscaler, DB failover, config rollout). Can we centralize action items and owners in this thread?
aj: I can pull the incident export and slice by service/region. Give me 24h — will post a CSV link.
sylvie: Adding a couple quick observations from the PMF: several P2s were caused by cron batch spikes at 02:00 UTC, leading to elevated memory and evictions.

devops-jen: Agree. From infra side, the autoscaler config defaults are too aggressive for small pools. We hit scale-down thrash a few times.
kevin: Also saw ~3 incidents where DB failover didn't trigger the read-only flag cleanup; apps kept retrying and thrashed connections.
maria: Good notes. Can we draft concrete remediation items here? I'll summarize and we can assign owners.

sylvie: Proposed items: 1) Autoscaler tuning & safeguard (limit min-replicas + cool-down). 2) Cron batch sharding + stagger windows. 3) DB failover runbook and post-failover cleanup job.
aj: Uploaded the raw CSV: https://redwood.s3/quarterly_incidents_q4.csv (filtered by severity, service). Quick query I used:
```sql
SELECT incident_id, created_at, severity, service, root_cause FROM incidents WHERE created_at >= '2025-10-01' AND severity IN ('P1','P2');
```

devops-jen: I'll own #1 (Autoscaler tuning). Deliverable: PR with new defaults + rollout plan. Target: 2025-11-10.
kevin: I'll pair with infra on #3 (DB runbook). Need a small test plan to simulate failover and verify cleanup. Target: 2025-11-17.
maria: Sylvie — can you own #2 (batch sharding/stagger)? Also please coordinate with product teams to change cron schedules where needed. Target: 2025-11-07.
sylvie: Assigned. I'll create a short RFC and list cron owners.

oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly incident retro sync scheduled Thu 15:00 UTC. Link: https://meet.redwood/retro

maria: For tracking — I'll create a GH issue per item and link back to the postmortems. Please include a short QA checklist and rollback plan in each PR.
aj: After we have owners, can we run a simple attribution: how many incidents would be prevented by item #1 vs #2 vs #3? I can run heuristics once PRs are live.

devops-jen: One more quick mitigation: add temporary rate-limiter for job enqueue during high memory%. Low effort, helps until batch sharding is live. I can spike that this week.
kevin: Noted. Also suggestion: surface read-only flag in telemetry dashboards so ops can detect partially-failed failovers early. I'll add a Grafana panel.

maria: Great. Next steps: owners to open issues by EOD tomorrow, include proposed rollout dates. We'll review at Thurs retro. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
